title: DC-area forecast: Summer surges back today with a few showers and storms
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly to mostly cloudy and humid with afternoon highs in the 80s. A line of storms west of the Beltway along I-66 tracks southward through western Fairfax, Prince William, and southern Fauquier counties through about 3:45 p.m. Elsewhere a few hit-or-miss showers and storms are possible this afternoon into evening.

What’s next? A cold front sinks south Friday, delivering nicer weather to end the workweek. The weekend is a mixed bag: cooler Saturday, then warmer and more humid Sunday with a heightened rain chance.

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: We're about a week past the average final day of 90-plus but could get there today, and humidity is high. It's not the September weather we dream of! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Thursday): Partly to mostly cloudy this afternoon with highs in the 80s and humidity on the uncomfortable side (dew points in the upper 60s to near 70). A few hit-or-miss showers and thunderstorms are possible at times during the afternoon into evening. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: A few hit-or-miss showers and storms remain possible through 10 p.m. or so. especially north of the Beltway. Remaining humid with dew points near 70. Lows range from the upper 60s to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): A weak cold front should sink south of the area. This means morning humidity diminishes through the day, with dew points perhaps falling into the 50s during the afternoon under partly to mostly sunny skies. Highs shoot for the low to mid-80s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear and cooler than tonight, thanks to the lower humidity levels. Lows should range from near 60 in the cooler spots north and west to the mid- and upper 60s in DC and other warm spots south and east. Confidence: Medium-High

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Cloudier Saturday, especially in the afternoon, when a passing shower is possible. Temperatures should make the upper 70s and low 80s for highs. Odds of rain or a rumble may rise into the evening, particularly north of DC. Confidence: Medium

A bit warmer and more humid on Sunday ahead of the next cold front. Partial sunshine leads temperatures toward the mid-80s or so as showers and a storm become likely during the afternoon or evening. Confidence: Medium

Mostly cloudy Monday and still on the humid side. The good news is it's cooler, with highs probably not getting out of the mid- and upper 70s. Some more showers are possible as well. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 17

Oppressive heat in 1991 sent temperatures to 96 degrees with extreme humidity, while in 2004 the remnants of Hurricane Ivan triggered a historic tornado outbreak across the region.
